question: Should OpenClaw permanently support plugin-authored AI-safety events and durable operator-queryable safety telemetry as core public contracts, or should this PR be narrowed to internal core diagnostics first?
rationale: This choice fixes the permanent plugin SDK, manifest, storage, Gateway, and operator-product boundaries; it cannot be safely inferred from tests or implemented as a mechanical repair.

options.title: Narrow to core diagnostics first
options.body: Remove the dormant plugin manifest/SDK surface and land only the owner-approved internal diagnostic boundaries that fit existing observability contracts.

options.title: Approve the full public contract
options.body: Keep the plugin and operator surfaces, but require explicit ownership, documented authorization and retention semantics, compatibility coverage, and fresh proof at the reviewed head.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Defer the taxonomy until a maintainer-sponsored design settles the core-versus-plugin boundary and operator product scope.

recommendation.title: Narrow to core diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Remove the dormant plugin manifest/SDK surface and land only the owner-approved internal diagnostic boundaries that fit existing observability contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing discussion directly requests this person’s decision on the public plugin SDK and operator telemetry boundary.
